properties.name: A design lives in its reflow2 server, not in the code repository it describes
properties.source: Anthony and Alex, 2026-09-25 (relayed in the dev_reflow2 hub session)
properties.statement: A design's home is the reflow2 server that holds it — local on the owner's machine, or hosted (flo2.io) — and not the repository of the code that implements it. A code repository needs nothing from reflow2; at most it carries an MCP configuration and an agent-instructions file, and for a project the owner does not control (bluesky, ophyd-async) even those live in user- or machine-level configuration, so a pull request upstream can never carry anything of reflow2's. Revisit when reflow2 designs are widely understood in repositories. From a discussion between Anthony and Alex, 2026-09-25.
